title: Getting Started with Tempo.Blazor.Mcp
overview: Tempo.Blazor.Mcp exposes discovery-first, machine-readable tools for Tempo editors. Notion authoring in 2.7 uses complete page aggregates, strict closed operation objects, optimistic page tokens, and one atomic save.
notes: Call AddTempoNotionMcpTools and register an INotionDataProvider for page lifecycle plus an INotionAggregateProvider for canonical recursive reads and atomic authoring.
Read with notion_get_block_tree before writing and submit the returned opaque page token in expectedPageVersionsJson.
Use notion_get_block_schema, notion_get_operation_catalog, and notion_get_authoring_guide instead of guessing nested JSON payloads.
Tempo.Blazor 2.7 has no granular or sequential compatibility fallback for block authoring.
